what: The claims cert-machine and dReal decide in tools/dreal-compare.js and tools/dreal-compare.py: the Contraprova flow-line gate's nine receipts (their checks, one claim per distinct check, the enclosures they print and the bracket of Colebrook's root) and the self-audit's entropy family (4 originals, 12 mutants). Every number is an exact decimal or rational string, or an exact enclosure [lo, hi] of an irrational or of a long rational; the runner encloses each in doubles and declares it a dReal variable. A query is the conjunction box ∧ params ∧ given ∧ its atoms. Regenerated byte for byte by node tools/dreal-compare.js --claims.

reading.rule: CERTIFIED iff notphi is unsat; REFUTED iff phi is unsat; otherwise REFUSED (delta-sat on both sides)
reading.precondition: as a rule; the gate certifies it or declines the receipt, never refutes it
reading.consistency: REFUTED iff phi (some declared input is consistent with the claim) is unsat; otherwise CONSISTENT, which is not a proof of existence
reading.universal: CERTIFIED iff every query is unsat
reading.support: HOLDS iff every query is unsat
